text: DSH Reproducible Build Proof 是面向 DSH 的开发工具插件，通过两个 DSH 工具检查明确提供的构建清单。它可提取清单中的哈希与计数，也可核验多个独立构建回执是否使用匹配的输入约定、不同构建者与操作方，并产生指定产物逐字节一致的判定；验证工具还能写出内容寻址报告并回读校验。适合需要比较独立重建结果的开发者。它不执行构建，也不需要 API 密钥或外部服务；运行需要 Node.js 22 或更高版本。

DSH Reproducible Build Proof adds DSH tools to inspect build manifests and check whether independent receipts agree on inputs and specified byte-identical outputs. Verify writes and reads back a content-addressed report. It does not run builds or need keys or network access; requires Node.js 22+.
想核对多个独立构建是否产出了完全相同的指定文件
有没有办法离线检查构建回执里的输入约定和产物哈希是否一致？
让 DSH 根据一份 JSON 清单判断独立重建是否复现成功
DSH Reproducible Build Proof 的「检查构建清单」功能：调用 inspect 工具读取显式 JSON 清单，返回证明 ID 哈希、输入摘要、回执数量和指定产物数量；不执行构建。
DSH Reproducible Build Proof 的「核验重建结果」功能：调用 verify 工具提供工作区内清单路径和报告目录，比较回执的输入、独立性与产物集合，输出复现判定及内容寻址报告。

dsh-reproducible-build-proof README · DSH Reproducible Build Proof：**Maintainer / Author：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen) · [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)**

An offline, deterministic evidence layer for DeepSeek Harness supply chains. It checks whether two or more independently operated builders recorded the same source revision, recipe, build type, parameters, dependency set and relevant environment contract, then produced byte-identical specified artifacts.

dsh-reproducible-build-proof README · DSH Reproducible Build Proof：It **does not execute** a build, install a package, authenticate provenance, issue a SLSA Verified Property, or claim protection against source, dependency or distribution threats. It verifies explicit hash-only receipts; use a provenance/signature verifier to establish receipt authenticity.

dsh-reproducible-build-proof README · Complementary boundary：- `dsh-release-proof` checks multiple download endpoints for HTTP status, length, version and SHA-256 agreement.
- `dsh-attestation-proof` verifies DSSE/in-toto signature, subject and signer-threshold policy.
- This plugin checks independent rebuild convergence: equivalent declared inputs, distinct allowed builders/operators/environments, and the exact specified output set.

dsh-reproducible-build-proof README · Complementary boundary：This follows the narrow reproducible-build definition of bit-for-bit identical specified outputs and the SLSA distinction that verified reproducibility requires two or more independently operated build platforms. It does not conflate reproducibility with total supply-chain security.

dsh-reproducible-build-proof README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin add github:dongsheng123132/dsh-reproducible-build-proof#COMMIT
```

The bundle exposes `dsh_reproducible_build_inspect` and `dsh_reproducible_build_verify` from one headless core. The independent MCP stdio server exposes `reproducible_build_inspect` and `reproducible_build_verify`. The CLI accepts `inspect` or `verify` plus an explicit JSON path.

dsh-reproducible-build-proof README · Install：See [`examples/reproduced.json`](examples/reproduced.json). Reports contain only hashes, sizes, counts, booleans and verdicts. Secret-shaped material, raw logs and body/content fields are rejected. The DSH verify tool reads a workspace-relative non-symlink manifest, writes only to an explicit workspace-relative `artifactDir`, creates deterministic content-addressed output exclusively, and verifies it by read-back.

npm test
npm run check
npm run smoke:plugin

dsh-reproducible-build-proof README · Install：Node.js 22 or newer is required. The verifier has no runtime dependency and makes no network request.

dsh-reproducible-build-proof README · DSH 可复现构建证据：作者 / 维护者：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen)· [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)

这是 DeepSeek Harness 供应链的离线、确定性证据层。它核验两个以上独立运营的构建者是否记录了相同的源码 revision、recipe、build type、参数、依赖集合和相关环境契约，并产出逐字节相同的指定产物。

它不执行构建、不安装包、不认证 provenance、不签发 SLSA Verified Property，也不声称覆盖源码、依赖或分发威胁。`dsh-release-proof` 对账下载源，`dsh-attestation-proof` 验证 DSSE/in-toto 签名；本插件只验证独立重建回执是否收敛。

输入只接受显式哈希清单，原始日志、正文和秘密形态字段会被拒绝。DSH 写盘工具只读取工作区内非符号链接文件，只写入显式 `artifactDir`，并对内容寻址报告执行独占创建和回读校验。
